email.body:
Hi {{ contact.first_name }},

Your blurb and outline for {{ custom_values.anthology_name }} are ready.

You can view the Blurb PDF here:
{{contact.anthology_blurb_pdf_url}}

And you can edit your Blurb Google Doc here:
{{contact.anthology_blurb_doc_url}}

You can view the Outline PDF here:
{{contact.anthology_outline_pdf_url}}

And you can edit your Outline Google Doc here:
{{contact.anthology_outline_doc_url}}

The PDF is yours to view. The Google Doc is the one you edit, and it is the version we use.

If you are happy with them, you can move to the next step by opening this link:
https://link.msgsndr.com/widget/form/<form_id>?anthology_id={{ contact.anthology_id }}&stage=s4_blurb_outline

Thank you for being part of {{ custom_values.anthology_name }}.

Warmly,
The Editors
